NARRATIVE AND PLANS FOR TYPE-1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT AT
1535-1539 NORTH ORLEANS STREET

The Applicant requests a zoning change for the property located at 1535-1539 North Orleans Street from
the B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District to B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District (Type 1) in order
to construct a fifth floor addition with eight (8) dwelling units to the existing twenty-four (24) unit four-
story building. With the addition, the building will be 58°-6” in height. The dwelling units are located
on floors two through five. The ground floor consists of twenty-four (24) vehicular parking spaces and
twelve (12) bicycle parking spaces. Bicycle parking will be increased to thirty-two (32) spaces. A
waiver of the loading berth requirement is being sought. The proposed building is approximately 462
feet from the Sedgwick CTA train stop and 182 feet from the North Avenue CTA bus line.

The proposed Project also requires the following zoning relief in accordance with the review and
approval procedures set forth in Section 17-13-0303-D of the Zoning Ordinance:

‘) A variation to increase the parking requirement from .5 spaces per dwelling unit to .75 spaces per
dwelling unit (Section 17-3-0308(4))

2) A variation to reduce the side setbacks from the required combined 10 feet to the combined 1
foot, 4 inches (existing condition). (Sections 17-3-0406 and 17-2-0309-A of the Zoning
Ordinance).

) A variation to eliminate the required loading berth (Section 17-10-1101).

) A variation to permit vehicle access from the street (Section 17-3-0504-G).
